transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Um... I guess I'm just having some trouble getting things done. The main thing is I just get pulled off track by... well, every little sound or thought, really. Like, if I'm trying to work on an application, a car outside or my phone... or just some random idea will send me somewhere else. I usually don't even notice it's happening until later. So... yeah. That's mainly it.
Do you often feel restless, fidgety, or like you need to keep moving?
Um... yeah, I guess. Like, if I'm sitting with someone, my leg is usually bouncing. Or I'll just be clicking a pen... or messing with my keys. I don't really realize I'm doing it most of the time.
Do you often blurt out answers or interrupt people before they finish speaking?

Yeah, sometimes. I mean... I cut people off a lot. Like my mom, or... the counselor I see sometimes. An answer just pops into my head and I... I just say it before they're done talking. I don't mean to, it just happens.
Do you have these attention problems in more than one place, like at work or school and also at home?

Um... yeah, I guess so. It's... it's just kind of everywhere. Like, at home, or... well, I don't really have a job right now, but when I did, it was the same thing there. It just... happens wherever I am.
Did these attention and restlessness problems start before you were 7 years old?

Um... yeah, I think so. Even back in elementary school... they were always moving my seat around. I guess because I talked out of turn a lot. And... I'd forget my homework, or just rush through worksheets and make careless mistakes. So... yeah, it's been a while.
Do you often find it hard to stay seated when you’re supposed to?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I mean... I can sit still if I have to. It's fine.
Do you often have trouble paying close attention to details or making careless mistakes in your work or tasks?

Yeah, I guess so. Like... I'm doing some automotive training right now, and... when I fill out the forms or look over parts lists, I'll just... miss a little box. Or copy a number down wrong. 

It's... I don't know. It makes me feel kind of dumb, because I actually know what I'm trying to do. It just happens.
Were you often physically overactive or unable to stay quiet in childhood?
Um... I don't really know. I don't remember being... overly active. Just normal, I guess.
Do you often feel physically restless or unable to stay still as an adult?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I used to play soccer, but I can't really do that like before. So... if I'm just sitting around the house, I get kind of... I don't know. It feels like I'm crawling out of my skin. I just end up pacing from room to room a lot.
As a child, were you often physically restless or hard to keep still, like getting up from your seat when you were supposed to stay seated?
No... I don't think so. I don't really remember getting out of my seat or anything like that. Like I said, I was just... normal, I think.
Before age 7, did you often have trouble paying attention in school or during activities?

Um... yeah, I guess. Even back in elementary school... I remember teachers moving my seat a lot. I guess I talked out of turn. And... I don't know, I'd forget my homework sometimes. Whenever we had worksheets, I'd just kind of... rush through them and make dumb mistakes. So... yeah.
Before age 7, did you often lose things you needed for school or activities, like pencils, books, or homework?
Um... no, not really. I mean, I don't remember losing things all the time. Maybe a pencil here and there, but... nothing crazy.
Do you often feel unable to relax and like you have to keep moving?

Um... yeah, I guess. Even on days when I don't have work or... training or whatever. I just... I don't know, I don't really just sit. I end up moving around a lot... like going from the kitchen out to the garage, or over to my game setup. It just feels like I'm... supposed to be doing something all the time, I guess.
Do you often feel restless or like you have to keep moving, even when you’re trying to relax?

I think I just said that... but yeah. Since I can't play soccer like I used to, just sitting around the house... it kind of makes me feel like I'm crawling out of my skin. So I just end up pacing from room to room.
Do you often have trouble waiting your turn?

Yeah, I guess. Like... if I'm at a clinic or just in line at the store, I get irritated pretty fast. I just end up shifting around a lot, checking my phone for the time over and over... I just want to get it over with.
Do you often interrupt or intrude on other people’s conversations or activities?
I mean... yeah, probably. I end up cutting people off a lot. Mostly my mom, or... the counselor. It's just... an answer pops into my head and I kind of just say it before they finish talking.
When you were a child, did you often fidget, squirm, or have trouble sitting still when you were supposed to stay seated?

I guess so. Um... even back in elementary school, I remember teachers were always moving my seat. They said I talked out of turn a lot. And I'd forget my homework... or just rush through the worksheets and make careless mistakes. So, yeah.
As a child, were you often physically fidgety or unable to keep your hands or feet still when you were supposed to sit quietly?
I don't really know. I mean, I already said they moved my seat around a lot... I guess I was just restless. I don't remember exactly what my hands or feet were doing.
As a child, did you often leave your seat when you were supposed to stay seated?
I don't really remember. I mean, I guess I probably got up sometimes, but... I don't know if it was more than other kids.
When you were a child, were you often noticeably more physically active or hyperactive than other kids?
I'm not sure. I mean, I played outside and stuff, but... I don't know if I was more active than anyone else. I just did normal kid things, I guess.
